actions.action: Stake the flower spike with soft plant ties every 2-3 inches
Push the stake deeper into the bark if it wobbles
Set the clear pot inside a heavier pot and fill the gap with gravel or pebbles
Remove extra support once the plant stays upright on its own
If it still tips, check that the pot isn't sitting at an angle on the saucer

reason: The answer identifies the top-heavy, unstable pot as the main cause, and its second fix (setting the pot inside a heavier pot) matches what the poster did; nothing it suggests is harmful.
